question: find places within 500 meters of the tower
sql: SELECT id, names->>'primary' AS name FROM lisbon_places WHERE ST_Distance_Sphere(geometry, ST_Point(-9.1393, 38.7072)) < 500

question: show buildings that contain the point at -9.14, 38.71
sql: SELECT id, names->>'primary' AS name FROM lisbon_buildings WHERE ST_Contains(geometry, ST_Point(-9.14, 38.71))

question: list all restaurants within the city center
sql: SELECT id, names->>'primary' AS name FROM lisbon_places WHERE basic_category = 'restaurant' AND ST_Within(geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(-9.16, 38.7, -9.12, 38.74))

question: find buildings touching the river
sql: SELECT id, names->>'primary' AS name FROM lisbon_buildings WHERE ST_Touches(geometry, ST_GeomFromText('LINESTRING(-9.15 38.72, -9.13 38.73)', 4326))

question: get all places intersecting the park boundary
sql: SELECT id, names->>'primary' AS name FROM lisbon_places WHERE ST_Intersects(geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON((-9.15 38.7, -9.15 38.72, -9.13 38.72, -9.13 38.7, -9.15 38.7))', 4326))

question: buildings within 1km of the main square
sql: SELECT id, names->>'primary' AS name, height FROM lisbon_buildings WHERE ST_Distance_Sphere(geometry, ST_Point(-9.1393, 38.7072)) < 1000
